<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Fusemachines
Inc. and Subsidiaries Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Automatic
conversion into common stock</b> - If the company completes the plan of merger as per the Merger Agreement (as defined in &#8220;Note
1 - Organization) before the January 2024 Convertible Notes maturity date in January 2025, the Company must notify the lender at least
5 days before the merger is finalized. Immediately preceding the merger, any outstanding amounts the Company owes under the January 2024
Convertible Notes will automatically turn into shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock. The number of shares converted is based on
the Conversion Amount, divided by the Conversion Price, which will be capped at a maximum value (the share price cap as discussed below).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Optional
conversion into preferred stock or common stock</b> &#8211; After the maturity date of this note in January 2025, the holder can choose
to turn the Conversion Amount into shares. There are two scenarios: (i) if converted in conjunction with the January 2024 Convertible
Notes Qualifying Financing after the maturity date of January 2025, the conversion will be to preferred stock. The number of shares will
be the Conversion Amount divided by the Conversion Price, or (ii) if converted at any other time that is not tied to a Qualifying Financing
after the maturity date of January 2025, the conversion will be to common stock. The number of shares will be based on the Conversion
Amount, divided by the maximum share price (the share price cap as discussed below).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Optional
conversion upon a liquidation event</b> &#8211; Before the maturity date in January 2025, or before the January 2024 Convertible Notes
convert into shares according to the optional conversion upon a qualifying financing, automatic conversion into common stock, or optional
conversion into preferred or common stock as discussed above, if the Company plans to sell off its assets or dissolve (when not part
of a merger, a &#8220;Liquidation Event&#8221;), the holder can: (i) choose to convert any Conversion Amount into common stock immediately
prior to the Liquidation Event. The number of shares to be calculated as the Conversion Amount, divided by a set price per share (the
share price cap as discussed below), or (ii) alternatively, choose to be paid in cash, which would be the Conversion Amount, payable
prior to the Liquidation Event. The Company must notify the holder at least 10 days before the Liquidation Event is expected to occur.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Liquidation
Preference Upon Conversion</b> &#8211; If the January 2024 Convertible Notes convert in the January 2024 Notes Qualifying Financing,
they will be converted into preferred stock such that the liquidation preference shall equal the Conversion Price.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>January
2024 Convertible Note A specific terms</b> &#8211; Upon the occurrence of a default (as defined in the January 2024 Notes Agreement and
discussed below), the holder can declare all amounts due and outstanding to be paid immediately. The proceeds received under the January
2024 Convertible Note A are to be used to repurchase <span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesIssued_iI_pid_c20240131__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--JanuaryTwoThousandTwentyFourConvertibleNoteAMember_zxOr8saNhRW8" title="Common stock shares, repurchases"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued" contextRef="AsOf2024-01-31_us-gaap_CommonStockMember_custom_JanuaryTwoThousandTwentyFourConvertibleNoteAMember" id="Fact001625" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">667,000</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of common stock held by Sameer Maskey, CEO of the Company. The share
price cap is $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--SharePrice_iI_pid_c20240131__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--JanuaryTwoThousandTwentyFourConvertibleNoteBMember_zQcVrKJMhb7l" title="Share price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharePrice" contextRef="AsOf2024-01-31_us-gaap_CommonStockMember_custom_JanuaryTwoThousandTwentyFourConvertibleNoteBMember" id="Fact001627" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">3.00</ix:nonFraction></span> per share.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>January
2024 Convertible Note B specific terms</b> &#8211; Upon the occurrence of a default (as defined in the January 2024 Notes Agreement and

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The

The January 2024 Convertible Notes are fully secured by <span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesIssued_iI_pid_c20240131_z211FJXq1Sk7" title="Common stock shares, issued"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued" contextRef="AsOf2024-01-31" id="Fact001633" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">3,600,000</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of common stock

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company qualified for and elected to account for the January 2024 Convertible Notes under the fair value option and, in doing so, bypassed
the analysis of potential embedded derivative features. The Company believes that the fair value option better reflects the underlying
economics of the January 2024 Convertible Notes. As a result, the January 2024 Convertible Notes were recorded at fair value upon issuance</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company evaluated the amendment agreement entered on February 4, 2025, under the guidance in ASC 470-50 Debt - Modifications and Extinguishments,
and it was determined terms of the amendment were not substantially different than the terms of the convertible notes prior to the Amendment.
Accordingly, the aforesaid amendment was accounted for as a debt modification.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The

for the year ended December 31, 2025, and December 31, 2024 respectively.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
January 2024 Convertible Notes were once again amended in July 2025 and basis the amendment the maturity date was revised from July 12,
2025, to October 18, 2025, pursuant to the third amendment. The Company applied the 10% cash flow test pursuant to ASC 470 to calculate
the difference between the present value of the amended note&#8217;s cash flows and the present value of the original remaining cash
flow and concluded that the results didn&#8217;t exceed the 10% factor, the debt modification is not considered substantially different
and therefore did not apply extinguishment accounting, rather it accounted for the modification on a prospective basis pursuant to ASC
470.</span></p>

Accordingly, the excess  of the consideration  over  the fair value amounting to $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentRepurchaseAmount_iI_pn2n3_c20240630_zj8ITD8dbbtc" title="Debt instrumental repurchase"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRepurchaseAmount" contextRef="AsOf2024-06-30" id="Fact001705" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">114.0</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand was  recorded as loss on extinguishment
of debt, with a corresponding adjustment in additional paid-in-capital,   in the consolidated statement of profit and loss for the year ended
December 31, 2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
June 2024 Convertible Note were once again amended in July 2025 and basis the amendment, the maturity date was revised from June 17, 2025,
to <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentMaturityDate_dd_c20250701__20250731__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--JuneTwoThousandTwentyFourConvertibleNotesAgreementMember_zP1lXuz55X5d" title="Maturity date"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-012025-07-31_custom_JuneTwoThousandTwentyFourConvertibleNotesAgreementMember" format="ixt:datemonthdayyearen" id="Fact001707" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentMaturityDate">June 17, 2026</ix:nonNumeric></span>, pursuant to the amendment. The Company applied the 10% cash flow test pursuant to ASC 470 to calculate the difference
between the present value of the amended note&#8217;s cash flows and the present value of the original remaining cash flow and concluded
that the results didn&#8217;t exceed the 10% factor, the debt modification is not considered substantially different and therefore did
not apply extinguishment accounting, rather it accounted for the modification on a prospective basis pursuant to ASC 470.</span></p>

Company incurred interest expense on promissory notes held at amortized cost and subsequently the promissory notes principal and accrued
and unpaid interest were repaid in cash upon the Closing of merger.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Fusemachines

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span style="text-decoration: underline">Others-
February 2025 Convertible Notes</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
connection with the second amendment to the Business Combination Agreement, Consilium Frontier Equity Fund, LP provided financing to Fusemachines Inc.
in the amount of $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1_c20250201__20250228_z40RckCHvcE9" title="Debt conversion amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" contextRef="From2025-02-012025-02-28" id="Fact001743" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">2,160,000</ix:nonFraction></span>, in exchange for a convertible note which note shall convert into shares of Fusemachines Inc. common stock
of at a price of $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--SharePrice_iI_c20250228_z5whIjtOTQ97" title="share price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharePrice" contextRef="AsOf2025-02-28" id="Fact001745" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.44</ix:nonFraction></span> per share (a) automatically at the time of the Business Combination, or (b) on July 12, 2025 at the option of
the holder, if not, then payable in cash.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Pursuant
to the terms of the Note and related Escrow Agreement, the proceeds are required to be deposited into an escrow account and will be released
to the Company only upon the consummation of the Business Combination.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Further,
per Section 4.2 of the Escrow Agreement &#8220;Upon the Closing, the Company, Investor and Fusemachines shall jointly deliver a Joint
Release Notice to the Escrow Agent directing the Escrow Agent to disburse all Funds held in the Escrow Account to the Fusemachines Inc.&#8221;
Accordingly, the escrowed funds are not freely available to the Company prior to joint instruction by the Investor, Fusemachines and
the Company.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
May 22, 2025, the proceeds from Consilium Frontier Equity Fund, LP have been received into an escrow account. </span>Upon closing of
the merger, these funds were subsequently released and received in the bank account of Fusemachines Inc.</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span style="text-decoration: underline">Impact
of reverse capitalization on convertible note </span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
connection with the consummation of the Business Combination on October 22, 2025, each Legacy Fusemachines convertible note, including
both related-party and non-related-party convertible notes, that was issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Closing was converted
into an aggregate of <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOptionsExercised_c20251022__20251022_znuAEmxaHNQe" title="Issuance of exercise share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOptionsExercised" contextRef="From2025-10-222025-10-22" id="Fact001747" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">8,048,770</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of Legacy Fusemachines common stock in accordance with the respective convertible note agreements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Convertible
notes that are exchanged for equity pursuant to their original contractual terms are accounted for in accordance with ASC 470-20, Debt
with Conversion and Other Options. Upon conversion, the carrying amount of the convertible debt is reclassified to equity, and no gain
or loss is recognized in earnings, as the conversion is executed in accordance with the original terms of the instruments.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Immediately
following such conversions, all shares of Legacy Fusemachines common stock issued upon conversion were exchanged for shares of Fusemachines
Inc. common stock based on the exchange ratio specified in the Business Combination Agreement.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

2025, other than related party note payable related to Dolma amounting $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--OtherNotesPayableCurrent_iI_pn3n3_c20251231_zKsTDVHVfVhj" title="Related party note payable"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:OtherNotesPayableCurrent" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001749" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">300</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span style="text-decoration: underline">Accounting

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8AA_zQ09zvbQbCIa" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Rights,
preferences and privileges of the Convertible Preferred Stock (Historical)</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
following summarizes the rights, preferences, and privileges of the Convertible Preferred Stock prior to its conversion at Closing</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Dividends</i>.
The Company may not pay dividends on other classes or series of stock (excluding dividends in common stock) before unless the holders
of the Company&#8217;s Convertible Preferred Stock receive, at the same time or before, a dividend on each of their shares. Upon the
declaration of a dividend for another class or series of stock (excluding common stock), the holders of the Convertible Preferred Stock
are entitled to receive dividends based on the equivalent amount if the other stocks were converted into common stock, times the number
of common stock shares that each Convertible Preferred Stock share could be converted into (as adjusted for stock splits, combinations
and reorganizations). No dividends have been declared to date.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Conversion</i>.
The series seed preferred stock is convertible, at the option of the holder, at any time and from time to time, into such number of fully
paid and nonassessable shares of common stock as is determined by dividing the series seed original issue price by the series seed conversion
price in effect at the time of conversion.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Voting
rights.</i> The holders of Convertible Preferred Stock are entitled to that number of votes on all matters presented to stockholders
equal to the number of shares of common stock then issuable upon conversion of such preferred stock. The holders of Convertible Preferred
Stock are entitled to elect one director of the Company.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Liquidation</i>.
In the event of any sale of substantially all of the assets, a merger, or liquidation, dissolution or winding up of the Company, the
holders of series seed-4 Convertible Preferred Stock then outstanding will be entitled to receive, in preference to the holders of all
other series of Convertible Preferred Stock and common stock, an amount equal to or greater than (a) $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_iI_pid_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeriesSeed4ConvertiblePreferredStockMember_zqzROzCyr1ie" title="Preferred stock liquidation preference, per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreference" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesSeed4ConvertiblePreferredStockMember" id="Fact001815" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">1.0553</ix:nonFraction></span> per share (as adjusted for
stock splits, combinations, and reorganizations) plus declared and unpaid dividends, if any, or (b) such amount per share as would have
been payable had all shares of series seed-4 Convertible Preferred Stock had been converted to common stock immediately prior to such
liquidation, dissolution or winding up or deemed liquidation event. Given that deemed liquidation event is within the control of the
common stockholders, the Convertible Preferred Stock is recognized as permanent equity within the consolidated statements of stockholders&#8217;
deficit.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

the payment of all preferential amounts required to the paid to the holders of shares of series seed-4 Convertible Preferred Stock, the
holders of series seed 3, 2, and 1 Convertible Preferred Stock will be entitled to receive, on a pari passu basis and in preference to
the holders of common stock, $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_iI_pid_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeriesSeed3ConvertiblePreferredStockMember_zNFHuRMTaMCl" title="Preferred stock liquidation preference, per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreference" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesSeed3ConvertiblePreferredStockMember" id="Fact001817" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.9379</ix:nonFraction></span>, $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_iI_pid_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeriesSeed2ConvertiblePreferredStockMember_z5nkO4RyMku6" title="Preferred stock liquidation preference, per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreference" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesSeed2ConvertiblePreferredStockMember" id="Fact001819" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.6704</ix:nonFraction></span>, and $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--PreferredStockLiquidationPreference_iI_pid_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__custom--SeriesSeed1ConvertiblePreferredStockMember_z6zHimqpzXWd" title="Preferred stock liquidation preference, per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreference" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SeriesSeed1ConvertiblePreferredStockMember" id="Fact001821" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.6704</ix:nonFraction></span>, respectively, per share plus declared and unpaid dividends, if any. After
the payment of all preferential amounts required to be paid to the holders of series seed-4 Convertible Preferred Stock, then the holders
of series seed 3, 2 and 1 Convertible Preferred Stock, shall be entitled to be paid out of the assets of the Company. After distributing
to all preferred stockholders, the remaining assets of the Company will be distributed ratably to the holders of the common stock on

<span id="xdx_823_z001QYXqIWD1">Revenue</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Fusemachines
Inc. and Subsidiaries Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Service
Type</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During
the year ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company had one significant service type, AI Solutions (products and services). For the
year ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, there were $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--Revenues_pn3n3_c20250101__20251231__srt--ProductOrServiceAxis__custom--AISolutionsMember_zkVg05MoDNX1" title="Revenues"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:Revenues" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_AISolutionsMember" id="Fact001890" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">7,581</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand and $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--Revenues_pn3n3_c20240101__20241231__srt--ProductOrServiceAxis__custom--AISolutionsMember_zjoAYlWrMF9b" title="Revenues"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:Revenues" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_AISolutionsMember" id="Fact001892" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">8,811</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand of AI Solutions (products and services) revenue.
The company had insignificant revenue from AI Solutions &#8211; Products for the year ended December 31, 2025, and 2024, respectively.
The revenue recognized for AI education services were $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--Revenues_pn3n3_c20250101__20251231__srt--ProductOrServiceAxis__custom--AIEducationServicesMember_zkYvll9xcR9d" title="Revenues"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:Revenues" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_AIEducationServicesMember" id="Fact001894" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">133</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand and <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--Revenues_pn3n3_dxL_c20240101__20241231__srt--ProductOrServiceAxis__custom--AIEducationServicesMember_zKr7hGdGXiF4" title="Revenues::XDX::-"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden: xdx2ixbrl1896">Nil</span></span> during the year ended December 31, 2025, and 2024.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Deferred

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During
the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company recognized revenue of $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--ContractWithCustomerLiabilityRevenueRecognized_pn2n3_c20250101__20251231_zAzf470myp55" title="Deferred revenue, revenue recognized"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityRevenueRecognized" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact001898" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">53.7</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand from the deferred revenue balance as of December 31,
2024. During the year ended December 31, 2024, the Company recognized revenue of $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--ContractWithCustomerLiabilityRevenueRecognized_pn2n3_c20240101__20241231_z6vP5ZckgnQg" title="Deferred revenue, revenue recognized"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityRevenueRecognized" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31" id="Fact001900" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">20.6</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand from the deferred revenue balance as

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Contract
Costs</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company recognizes the incremental costs of obtaining contracts as an expense when incurred if the amortization period of the assets
that the Company otherwise would have recognized is one year or less. Management expects that commission fees paid to sales representatives
as a result of obtaining service contracts and contract renewals, are recoverable and therefore the Company&#8217;s consolidated balance
sheets included capitalized balances in the amount of $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--CapitalizedContractCostNet_iI_pn2n3_c20251231_zRlIgudbsyhc" title="Capitalized contract cost"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostNet" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001902" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">18.9</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand and $<span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--CapitalizedContractCostNet_iI_pn2n3_c20241231_zFtLTVmBPptb" title="Capitalized contract cost"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostNet" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact001904" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">21.9</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand as of December 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024
which represents the current portion and is included within prepaid expenses and other current assets, respectively and $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--OtherAssets_iI_pn2n3_c20251231_zrAidLx3128c" title="Other assets"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:OtherAssets" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact001906" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">3.2</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand
and $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--OtherAssets_iI_pn3n3_c20241231_zKkRhUZso2L9" title="Other assets"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:OtherAssets" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact001908" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">5</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand, as of December 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024, respectively, which are included within other assets. Capitalized commission
fees are amortized on a straight-line basis over the average period of service contracts of approximately two years and are included
in selling and marketing in the accompanying consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive loss. Amortization recognized during
the year ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 was $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--CapitalizedContractCostAmortization_pn2n3_c20250101__20251231_zGzbZmZczBBe" title="Capitalized contract cost amortization"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostAmortization" contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" id="Fact001910" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">31.1</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand and $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--CapitalizedContractCostAmortization_pn2n3_c20240101__20241231_z3ncz8HI6pO6" title="Capitalized contract cost amortization"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CapitalizedContractCostAmortization" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31" id="Fact001912" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">36.2</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand, respectively.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-01to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001946" name="us-gaap:DisclosureOfCompensationRelatedCostsShareBasedPaymentsTextBlock"><p id="xdx_800_eus-gaap--DisclosureOfCompensationRelatedCostsShareBasedPaymentsTextBlock_zgiX1FL5g3V8" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
14. <span id="xdx_829_zEImDY4whom1">Stock-based Compensation</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 1.45pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Effective
June 2014, the Company adopted an equity-based compensation plan, the 2014 Equity Incentive Plan (the &#8220;2014 Plan&#8221;), which
allows for the grant of stock options, stock issuances and other equity interests in the Company to the Company&#8217;s officers, directors,
employees and consultants. The 2014 Plan is administrated by the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors, or a committee appointed by the
Board. In February 2023, the Company&#8217;s board of directors and stockholders adopted the 2023 Equity Incentive Plan (the &#8220;2023
Plan&#8221;), which provides for the grant of incentive stock options, restricted stock awards and restricted stock units (&#8220;RSUs&#8221;)
to eligible employees, directors and consultants of the Company. With the introduction of the 2023 Plan, shares are no longer available
for future grants under the 2014 Plan. Awards outstanding under the 2014 Plan will be governed by the 2023 Plan.<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized_iI_pid_c20230228__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwentyTwentyThreePlanMember_zlLEeElM685j" title="Common stock were authorized for issuance"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized" contextRef="AsOf2023-02-28_custom_TwentyTwentyThreePlanMember" id="Fact001948" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">3,258,230</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of Common
Stock were authorized for issuance under the 2023 Plan to officers, directors, employees and consultants of the Company.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
2023 Plan was amended and approved by the stockholders of the Company in December 2023 to increase the number of shares of the Company&#8217;s
Common Stock reserved for issuance under the Fusemachines Inc. 2023 Amended and Restated Equity Plan (the &#8220;2023 Equity Incentive
Plan&#8221;) by <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance_iI_pid_c20230228__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwentyTwentyThreeEquityIncentivePlanMember_zU3nXFSR2f7" title="Common stock reserved for issuance"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance" contextRef="AsOf2023-02-28_custom_TwentyTwentyThreeEquityIncentivePlanMember" id="Fact001950" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">391,525</ix:nonFraction></span> to <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance_iI_pid_c20231231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwentyTwentyThreeEquityIncentivePlanMember_zodbYSRXiX5" title="Common stock reserved for issuance"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance" contextRef="AsOf2023-12-31_custom_TwentyTwentyThreeEquityIncentivePlanMember" id="Fact001952" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">3,649,755</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of common stock.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
connection with the Business Combination, which was accounted for as a reverse recapitalization, the number of shares under the 2023
Equity Incentive Plan was adjusted to reflect the exchange ratio established in the business combination agreement. Accordingly, all
share and per share amounts under the plan have been retrospectively adjusted to reflect the conversion of Legacy Fusemachines equity
into the Company&#8217;s common stock</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify">As
of December 31, 2025, <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant_iI_pid_do_c20251231__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwentyTwentyThreePlanMember_zCY9n4Sbs0P5" title="Common stock were available for future grant"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_TwentyTwentyThreePlanMember" id="Fact001954" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">no</ix:nonFraction></span>
shares of Common Stock were available for future grant under the 2023 Plan, as the 2023 Plan was replaced in its entirety by the 2025 Plan which was adopted in connection with the Business
Combination. </p>

respectively. As of December 31, 2025, total stock-based compensation expense not yet recognized related to unvested stock options was

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Cashless
Exercise of Stock Options</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
August 2025, certain Fusemachines employees exercised <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOptionsExercised_pid_c20250801__20250831__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_z7JCfrki1gK2" title="Stock options exercised, shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOptionsExercised" contextRef="From2025-08-012025-08-31_us-gaap_CommonStockMember" id="Fact002065" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">745,896</ix:nonFraction></span> options to purchase Fusemachines Inc. Common Stock. The exercise prices
for the <span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesOther_pid_c20250801__20250831__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zyNNSEvitAVg" title="Exercise price option"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesOther" contextRef="From2025-08-012025-08-31_us-gaap_CommonStockMember" id="Fact002067" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">745,896</ix:nonFraction></span> options were paid on a cashless basis via net share settlement resulting in the net share issuance of <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues_pid_c20250801__20250831__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zdvG66cz9ila" title="Issuance of shares"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" contextRef="From2025-08-012025-08-31_us-gaap_CommonStockMember" id="Fact002069" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">666,662</ix:nonFraction></span> shares
of Fusemachines Inc. Common Stock. The transaction has been accounted under the guidance of ASC 718 - Stock Compensation. The cashless
exercise mechanism does not change the substantive terms or fair-value-based measure of the awards and therefore does not constitute
a modification under ASC 718.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>The
Promissory Notes Transaction</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Early
Exercise of Stock Options</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company permits certain employees and directors to exercise stock options granted under the 2023 Plan prior to vesting. In February 2023,
the Company&#8217;s Chief Executive Officer, Mr. Maskey and other three executives early exercised a total of <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingNumber_iI_c20230228__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__custom--FebruaryOptionsAwardsMember_zU9ybsTN3Fp7" title="Stock option outstanding"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingNumber" contextRef="AsOf2023-02-28_custom_FebruaryOptionsAwardsMember" id="Fact002071" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">1,625,321</ix:nonFraction></span> stock options
prior to vesting (The February Options Awards)&#894; however, in lieu of the cash consideration required to exercise the stock options,
these individuals each provided a <span id="xdx_906_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod_pid_dp_uPure_c20230228__20230228__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_z1DJ5ZRPH7H2" title="Bearing interest percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod" contextRef="From2023-02-282023-02-28_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002073" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">3.82</ix:nonFraction></span>% interest bearing non-recourse note (the &#8220;2023 Promissory Notes&#8221;), for an aggregate
principle of $<span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentFaceAmount_iI_pn2n3_c20230228__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zErhC7WG9As" title="Aggregate principle"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" contextRef="AsOf2023-02-28_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002075" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">1,136.2</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand. The notes are scheduled to mature in <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentMaturityDateDescription_c20230228__20230228__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_z8q8C5O2nIc8" title="Maturity date"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2023-02-282023-02-28_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002077" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentMaturityDateDescription">February 2030</ix:nonNumeric></span>.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
nonrecourse nature of the loan secured by the shares pledged as collateral essentially provides the employee with rights like that of
an option and thus no receivable for amounts due under the 2023 Promissory Notes was recorded on the Company consolidated balance sheets.
While the shares of common stock purchased by the employees in exchange for the 2023 Promissory Notes are considered legally issued,
the shares are not deemed, for accounting purposes, outstanding and are considered restricted until all of the options are fully vested
and the outstanding principal and accrued interest due on the note is repaid in full.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
issuance of the 2023 Promissory Notes resulted in an additional stock-based compensation expense of <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense_pn2n3_dxL_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zjtp4oAjEMQi" title="Stock-based compensation expense::XDX::-"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden: xdx2ixbrl2079">Nil</span></span> and $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense_pn2n3_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zB4hFLdDa2t1" title="Stock-based compensation expense"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002081" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">11.7</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand for the year
ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively, based on the grant-date fair value of the Promissory Notes, which was determined using
the Black-Scholes Model.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
assumptions used in deriving the grant-date fair value of the 2023 Promissory Notes via the Black-Scholes Model were as follows: (i)
a stock price of $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--SharePrice_iI_pid_c20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zbfYS2T3xCe" title="Stock price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharePrice" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002083" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.88</ix:nonFraction></span> per share, (ii) an exercise price of $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExercisePrice_iI_pid_c20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zFmTjy6yULO4" title="Exercise price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExercisePrice" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002085" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.70</ix:nonFraction></span> per share, (iii) an estimated risk-free interest rate of <span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsRiskFreeInterestRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zKRgF5Ejgyvg" title="Risk-free interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsRiskFreeInterestRate" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002087" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">4.02</ix:nonFraction></span>%, (iv)
an expected term of <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExpectedTerm1_dtY_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zTHdkHpBHCT2" title="Expected term"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact002089" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExpectedTerm1">3.50</ix:nonNumeric></span> years, (v) volatility of <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExpectedVolatilityRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_z4DHkOiJMaag" title="Volatility"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExpectedVolatilityRate" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002091" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">75</ix:nonFraction></span>%, and (vi) a dividend yield of <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExpectedDividendRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zy7wr73c7XOa" title="Dividend yield"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardFairValueAssumptionsExpectedDividendRate" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002093" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0</ix:nonFraction></span>%. These assumptions resulted in a grant-date fair
value of approximately $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsGrantsInPeriodWeightedAverageGrantDateFairValue_pid_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zVPFn4XhfR0f" title="Grant-date fair value per option"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsGrantsInPeriodWeightedAverageGrantDateFairValue" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_TwoThousandTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002095" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.53</ix:nonFraction></span> per option.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"></p><p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Fusemachines
Inc. and Subsidiaries Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company continues to recognize expenses for the original option award of <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingNumber_iI_c20230228__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__custom--FebruaryOptionsAwardsMember_zq5piQiNiRFh" title="Stock option outstanding"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsOutstandingNumber" contextRef="AsOf2023-02-28_custom_FebruaryOptionsAwardsMember" id="Fact002097" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">1,625,321</ix:nonFraction></span> shares granted in February 2023 (the &#8220;February
Option Awards&#8221;), which were early exercised in exchange for Promissory Notes. The early exercise is not considered substantive
for accounting purposes until the vesting requirements are met through continued employment and service to the Company. As of December
31, 2025 and 2024, the Company recognized <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualAllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense_pn3n3_dxL_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__custom--FebruaryOptionsAwardsMember_z6q3TzfORuf2" title="Stock-based compensation expense recognized::XDX::-"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden: xdx2ixbrl2099">Nil</span></span> and $<span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualAllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense_pn2n3_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__custom--FebruaryOptionsAwardsMember_zdgmewTP2ZGh" title="Stock-based compensation expense recognized"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualAllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_FebruaryOptionsAwardsMember" id="Fact002101" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">41.4</ix:nonFraction> </span>thousand, respectively, in stock-based compensation expense related to the February
Option Awards. The unrecognized stock-based compensation expense related to the February Option Awards was <span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognized_iI_pn3n3_dxL_c20241231__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__custom--FebruaryOptionsAwardsMember_zc0pFSwe7JEg" title="Unrecognized stock-based compensation expense::XDX::-"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden: xdx2ixbrl2103">Nil</span></span>. The weighted-average
grant-date fair value per share of the February Option Awards was $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsGrantsInPeriodWeightedAverageGrantDateFairValue_pid_c20250101__20251231__us-gaap--AwardTypeAxis__custom--FebruaryOptionsAwardsMember_zyGO7mRvkDg4" title="Grant-date fair value per option"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardOptionsGrantsInPeriodWeightedAverageGrantDateFairValue" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-12-31_custom_FebruaryOptionsAwardsMember" id="Fact002105" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.50</ix:nonFraction></span>.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Repayment
of the Promissory Notes</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
January 2024, the Company repurchased <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodShares_pid_c20240101__20240131_zRunAuUogLv1" title="Repurchased shares of common stock"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodShares" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-01-31" id="Fact002107" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">438,903</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of common stock from Sameer Maskey, the CEO, at a price of $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--SharePrice_iI_pid_c20240131_zvRhMuuleGAd" title="Share price"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharePrice" contextRef="AsOf2024-01-31" id="Fact002109" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">6.61</ix:nonFraction></span> per share, totalling
$<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodValue_pn2n3_c20240101__20240131_zJ0zUqHHJZyh" title="Repurchased shares of common stock, value"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodValue" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-01-31" id="Fact002111" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">2,902.7</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand (the &#8220;Repurchase Consideration&#8221;). Mr. Maskey applied $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--RepaymentsOfNotesPayable_pn2n3_c20240101__20240131__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwentyTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zQ3MqBtyAiU3" title="Repayments of promissory note"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:RepaymentsOfNotesPayable" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-01-31_custom_TwentyTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002113" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">902.7</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand of the Repurchase Consideration toward
repayment of his 2023 Promissory Note to the Company. Upon repayment, the 2023 Promissory Note, along with any accrued interest, was
settled, and the vested shares pledged under the 2023 Promissory Notes are now considered exercised. As of the December 31, 2025, there
were no shares which were subject to vesting.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Forgiveness
of Promissory Notes</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
August 2024, the Company&#8217;s board of directors approved the forgiveness of the 2023 Promissory Notes totaling $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--ExtinguishmentOfDebtAmount_pn2n3_c20240801__20240831__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwentyTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zGOF8yCSMe3c" title="Debt forgiveness"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ExtinguishmentOfDebtAmount" contextRef="From2024-08-012024-08-31_custom_TwentyTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002115" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">262.2</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand (excluding
interest) for three of its executives. The forgiveness of these 2023 Promissory Notes effectively modified the strike price to zero,
allowing the executives to retain shares at no cost.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
accordance with ASC 718, the incremental value of the modification was calculated as the difference between the fair value of the modified
award and the fair value of the original award immediately before the modification. As of December 31, 2024, the Company recognized $<span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualAllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense_pn2n3_c20240101__20241231__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--TwentyTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember_zkqFiRjCPUMi" title="Stock-based compensation expense recognized"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredCompensationArrangementWithIndividualAllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_TwentyTwentyThreePromissoryNotesMember" id="Fact002117" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-2" scale="3" unitRef="USD">227.2</ix:nonFraction></span>
thousand in stock based compensation expense related to this modification.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Adoption
of 2025 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
October 22, 2025, the Board of Directors of the Company approved the 2025 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan (the &#8220;2025 Plan&#8221;).
The 2025 Plan provides for the grant of equity-based awards to employees, directors, officers, and other eligible service providers of
the Company and its subsidiaries.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
connection with the adoption of the 2025 Plan, an aggregate of <span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance_iI_c20251022__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember__us-gaap--PlanNameAxis__custom--TwoThousandTwentyFiveOmnibusEquityIncentivePlanMember_zr79sE3OeKli" title="Common stock were reserved for issuance"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockCapitalSharesReservedForFutureIssuance" contextRef="AsOf2025-10-22_us-gaap_CommonStockMember_custom_TwoThousandTwentyFiveOmnibusEquityIncentivePlanMember" id="Fact002119" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">1,500,000</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of the Company&#8217;s Common Stock were reserved for
issuance pursuant to awards granted under the 2025 Plan. The types of awards that may be granted under the 2025 Plan include, but are
not limited to, stock options, restricted stock, restricted stock units, stock appreciation rights, performance-based awards, and other
stock-based awards, as determined by the Board of Directors or a designated committee thereof.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">No
awards had been granted under the 2025 Plan as of period ended December 31, 2025. Accordingly, the adoption of the 2025 Plan did not
have any impact on the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements as of that date.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Convertible Notes were also outstanding as of December 31, 2024, which could obligate the Company to issue preferred shares upon the
occurrence of various future events at prices and in amounts that are not determinable until the occurrence of those future events. Because
the necessary conditions for the conversion of the Convertible Notes have not been satisfied as of December 31, 2024, the Company has
excluded the Convertible Notes from the table above and the calculation of diluted net loss per share. (Refer to &#8220;Note 10 - Long-Term
Debt &#8220;)</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company has also entered into a contingent obligation to issue <span id="xdx_907_ecustom--SharesIssuedForContingentObligation_iI_pid_c20251231__us-gaap--StatementEquityComponentsAxis__us-gaap--CommonStockMember_zuJM7oSbdybg"><ix:nonFraction name="FUSE:SharesIssuedForContingentObligation" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_us-gaap_CommonStockMember" id="Fact002170" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">45,000</ix:nonFraction></span></span>
<span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">shares of its common stock to a certain vendor in connection
with an outstanding accounts payable balance as part of a settlement agreement (refer to &#8220;Note 17 - Commitment and Contingencies&#8221;).
The issuance of common stock is contingent upon the completion the Merger (refer to &#8220;Note 1 - Organization&#8221;). As the Merger
had not taken place as of December 31, 2024, the conditions for the issuance of common stock have not been satisfied. Accordingly, the
Company has excluded the common stock shares arising from this contingent obligation from the table above and the calculation of diluted
net loss per share. Upon the closing of the business combination, the Company settled its obligation under the Second Agreement through
